name: OSM Sansha source-defined partial administrative reference 2026-10-03

limitations: Community-maintained OSM administrative reference, not an authoritative surveyed or legally current administrative boundary.

Child source descriptions restrict their scope to the part described by OSM contributors as controlled by China. That description has not been independently verified here and is not a statement on sovereignty.
These polygons include sea. They are not island outlines, a terrestrial land mask, an exhaustive island/reef inventory, or the full legal/claimed maritime extent.

Zhongsha relation 6753119 retains legacy name/code 460323 and is stored as a separate OSM subarea. Official 2020 district structure has Xisha and Nansha, with Xisha administering Zhongsha; the legacy OSM row must not become a third current district.
OSM edit timestamps are object-edit dates, not dates of authoritative survey. A relation date alone does not date all member ways or nodes.
ODbL re-use permission and attribution do not establish public-map approval, official cartographic compliance, sovereignty, or statistical-join correctness.
Completeness is verified only for referenced outer-way/node geometry of these four OSM objects in the downloaded snapshot; completeness of real-world administration or islands remains unverified.
